conclusion: Removing spherical/geodesic operations did not reduce the held-out detectability signature. Euclidean residual preserved fidelity and rank and avoided a geodesic saturation failure, but official AUC remained about 0.695. Free Euclidean failed. Geometry is therefore not supported as the primary bottleneck; stable whole-span CLS prediction from child CLS remains the likely limitation.
